name: The Run Under the Strand
description: A fire on the kiln at four miles reads as a harbour light, and whatever came off the Grace before she broke did not go up the beach. It went under it.

stages.name: Find the run
stages.description: It goes in at the back of the beach and comes out somewhere up on the downs, which is the whole point of it.

stages.name: Who is holding it
stages.description: Two men who did not expect the far end to be walked from this direction, and one thing that was already down here.

objectives.description: Clear the far end of the run.
